items.headline: minor speed bump for MTP with Qwen3.6-27B-MTP Q6_K_XL
items.summary: I'm on Macbook M5 Max with 128GB RAM Running a test in openwebui using llama-server (llama.cpp): unsloth/Qwen3.6-27B-UD-Q6_K_XL.gguf (non MTP): 19tps unsloth/Qwen3.6-27B-UD-Q6_K_XL.gguf (MTP): 22.3tps So nothing like the massive improvements I hear about. Possibly my own settings though. both use: --temp 0.6 --top-p 0.8 --top-k 20 --min-p 0.00 --cache-ram 24576 --batch-size 4096 --ubatch-size 2048  edit: forgot to add that I was using --spec-draft-n-max 2 have changed to 3 and also added --spec-
